title: Homemade Paneer from 2 Litres of Milk

ingredients.as_written: 2 Litres Toned milk (I am using Amul)
3-4 tbsp of Vinegar/ Lemon Juice of 2-2.5 lemons

steps: Boil the milk, and turn off the flame once it comes up. Add vinegar/ lemon juice and stir on low flame until the green water separates (you may need a little more vinegar/lemon juice depending on the milk quality). Once the whey water separates, strain the paneer and shape it with the help of a spoon. Let it sit in the strainer for 30 minutes and its ready!!
You can use the whey water to make gravies, knead doughs or to water plants.

flags.note: No protein source reaches 35 % of the protein (CONTEXT §4), so it has no main protein.
